notes: Free Trial only, NOT a permanent free tier (docs FAQ 2026-08-15: 'Is there a permanently free tier? Developer (pay-as-you-go, from $10) removes hourly/daily caps. 2026-08-15: no permanent free tier (FAQ: "Is there a permanently free tier? No"); $5 trial credits require a verified payment method and expire in 30 days — listed as trial-only like fly-io.
